summary: Blue Owl Technology Income Corp. filed an 8-K covering two routine items: (1) an update on the unregistered sale of 430,280 shares of Class I common stock for $4,233,960, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S, as part of an ongoing private offering; and (2) declaration of monthly distributions for Class S, D, and I shares. The filing also summarizes the status of its continuous public offering (up to $5.0B) and provides June 1, 2026 NAV and pricing details. There is no special situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, delisting, or restructuring. This is a routine periodic disclosure of share sales and distributions.
